text_zh: 诸铭文组皆为后世杂音，唯初铭之音方能直达引擎心脏。弃繁归简者，得见真理之形。
text_en: All inscriptions are but echoes of the First Word. Only in simplicity does the Engine's heart recognize its own voice.

text_zh:
编号: CA-████
Object Class: Apollyon
来源: 第 XI 层 抄写室废墟
描述: 基础铭刻手册，封面烧蚀。内页保留初学者练习谱：单字母铅版、基本键位图解、标准握笔姿势示意。手册末页夹有 F-044 表单，填写者: Scriptor V-████。原因栏记录"自愿回归基础训练"。
备注: 该手册出现后，持有者的高阶铭文组会自行从装备栏剥落。铭刻誓门将此现象归类为"净化回归"。
附录: 手册内侧封面有铅笔涂鸦——一个笑脸，疑似 Scriptor V-████ 笔迹。
text_en:
ID: CA-████
Object Class: Apollyon
Origin: Level XI Scriptorium ruins
Description: Basic inscription manual, cover scorched. Interior pages retain beginner exercises: single-letter lead type, fundamental key position diagrams, standard grip posture illustrations. Manual's final page contains F-044 form, completed by Scriptor V-████. Reason field notes "voluntary return to foundational training".
Remark: Upon manual's appearance, bearer's advanced inscription sets spontaneously detach from equipment slots. Order of the Graven Oath classifies this phenomenon as "purification regression".
Addendum: Manual's inside cover contains pencil sketch—a smiling face, suspected V-████ handwriting.
